capabilities._note: Tags and lyrics under its own section tags; no tempo, key or length input (tags; its length a cap). Measured outside the repo 2026-11-03/04 with heartlib, the same model and codec (docs/SOUND.md 'Measured: MiniMax Music 3, HeartMuLa and Magenta RealTime 2'): **a song model only**. It sings whatever its tags say (instrumental asked: a vocal stem 2-7 dB under the mix), the tempo isn't held (96 asked: 80-114), the words came through in two takes of three (a word error rate of 0.12 and 0.31; the third sang the song, then kept going with lines of its own). MiniMax Music 3 and YuE2 both did better; it is offered as a third song option. Apache-2.0 weights (HeartMuLa/heartlib).

template._note: HeartMuLaGenerator's duration_seconds: whole seconds, 10 to 600; the song may end sooner.

binding._note: monnky's ComfyUI-RT-HeartMuLa (it carries heartlib): HeartMuLaLoader (the happy-new-year 3B in the folder its dropdown calls HeartMuLa-oss-3B, the 2026-01-23 codec, no quantization: its default 4-bit needs bitsandbytes; bf16, the codec fp32 as heartlib advises), the tags through a core PrimitiveStringMultiline (the sampler's tags take only a link), HeartMuLaGenerator (cfg 1.5 and top-k 50 as heartlib's pipeline, the seed), SaveAudio. The sampler fades the take's last 2.5 s and peak-normalises it.

nodes._note: monnky/ComfyUI-RT-HeartMuLa (features.PACKS); its requirements add torchtune, torchao and vector-quantize-pytorch to ComfyUI's Python (a dry run 2026-11-04 left torch, transformers and numpy as they were). Its repo names a LICENSE file it doesn't have; the heartlib it carries is Apache-2.0.

fetches._note: HeartMuLaLoader reads Hugging Face folders from models/HeartMuLa: <model_name>/, <codec_name>/, and gen_config.json and tokenizer.json beside them. Not fetched by the pack (its README says to clone them): the Features window downloads them, each where the loader looks (`path`), and the target isn't ready without them. The happy-new-year 3B (heartlib's recommendation, what was measured) goes in the folder the dropdown calls HeartMuLa-oss-3B.
